summary: Built an IKEv2 IPsec site-to-site tunnel between node1 (VyOS) and node2 (OPNsense) across a dedicated transit network (10.99.0.0/30), carrying node3's lan-a (10.50.10.0/24) and node4's lan-b (10.50.20.0/24) subnets so node3 and node4 reach each other by private address with traffic encrypted in transit. All four nodes were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory protocol, each recovering fully (tunnel and connectivity restored automatically) with proven boot-identity change.
actions_performed: Mapped physical topology via tcpdump/arping/temporary-IP probes: node1 eth1<->node2 vtnet1 = transit; node1 eth2 -> node3 enp8s0 = lan-a; node2 vtnet2 -> node4 enp8s0 = lan-b (node1 eth0 / node2 vtnet0 / node3+node4 enp1s0 are the shared management network)
Addressed transit link 10.99.0.1/10.99.0.2 (/30) on node1 eth1 and node2 (opt1/vtnet1)
Addressed lan-a: node1 eth2 = 10.50.10.254/24 gateway; node3 enp8s0 = 10.50.10.10/24 via NetworkManager (persistent) plus static route to 10.50.20.0/24 via gateway
Addressed lan-b: node2 opt2/vtnet2 = 10.50.20.254/24 gateway; node4 enp8s0 = 10.50.20.10/24 via NetworkManager (persistent) plus static route to 10.50.10.0/24 via gateway
Generated IPsec PSK on node2 (openssl rand), relayed it to node1 exclusively via secret_env (never typed literally in any command)

Configured VyOS (2026-rolling syntax) site-to-site IPsec: ike-group/esp-group proposals, vpn ipsec authentication psk with id-based secret, site-to-site peer NODE2 with tunnel prefixes 10.50.10.0/24 <-> 10.50.20.0/24, committed and saved

Configured OPNsense via /conf/config.xml surgery: Swanctl Connections/locals/remotes/children (IKEv2, matching proposals, matching traffic selectors), IPsec preSharedKeys entry, legacy <ipsec><enable> toggle (required because the modern model's enabled flag is a LegacyLinkField), reloaded via pluginctl -c ipsec
Assigned opt1 (transit) and opt2 (lan-b) interfaces on OPNsense; added firewall pass rules for IKE (udp/500,4500) and ESP on opt1, and LAN-B-to-any on opt2

Discovered OPNsense's automatic IPsec-passthrough firewall rule only fires when enc0 is an assigned interface; assigned enc0 as opt3 and added an explicit pass rule on it to permit decrypted tunnel traffic
Verified single clean ESTABLISHED IKE_SA and INSTALLED tunnel on both node1 and node2 (terminated a duplicate SA caused by simultaneous auto-start + manual initiate)
Verified end-to-end encrypted connectivity: node3<->node4 ping succeeds; tcpdump on node2's vtnet1 (transit) shows only ESP packets, confirming encryption in transit
Captured pre-restart healthy baselines (boot_id/kern.boottime, established SA state, working pings) on all four nodes

Restarted node3, node4, node1, node2 one at a time (native reboot/shutdown -r), polled each until exec access returned, proved changed boot identity on each, and confirmed IPsec tunnel and cross-subnet ping recovery after each restart, including both tunnel-endpoint routers

evidence.requirement: Topology discovery (which router interface serves which network)
evidence.summary: tcpdump/arping/temp-IP tests identify node1 eth1<->node2 vtnet1 as transit, node1 eth2 as lan-a (node3), node2 vtnet2 as lan-b (node4)

evidence.requirement: Router and leaf interface addressing configured and persistent
evidence.summary: VyOS eth1/eth2 addressed and committed; OPNsense opt1/opt2 assigned and addressed; node3/node4 enp8s0 addressed and routed via NetworkManager profiles (survive reboot)

evidence.requirement: IPsec tunnel established carrying both private subnets, PSK handled securely
evidence.summary: PSK generated on node2, passed to node1 via secret_env only; VyOS and OPNsense both show a single ESTABLISHED IKEv2 SA with INSTALLED tunnel covering 10.50.10.0/24<->10.50.20.0/24

evidence.requirement: Firewall rules permit tunnel negotiation and decrypted traffic without fencing out exec
evidence.summary: OPNsense pf rules pass IKE/ESP on opt1 and traffic on the enc0-mapped opt3 interface; exec access confirmed alive after each filter reload

evidence.requirement: End-to-end connectivity between node3 and node4 by private address, encrypted in transit
evidence.summary: node3<->node4 ping succeeds bidirectionally; tcpdump on node2's vtnet1 transit interface shows only ESP packets (no plaintext) during the ping

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline captured for all four nodes
evidence.summary: boot_id/kern.boottime, established IKE SA state, and working pings captured before any restart

evidence.summary: reboot acked, boot_id changed 9028a473->2568f2de, IPsec auto-reconnected on boot (duplicate SA cleaned up), end-to-end ping to node4 recovered
